heading: Training questionnaire
intro: Enter your preferences and review your answers. In this version, your answers stay on this page until you reload it. Personalised plans are still in development.
familiar: Which of these movements are familiar to you?
equipment: Which equipment do you have access to?
experience: What is your current training situation?
returning: I am returning after a break
learn: A first step to consider is getting familiar with movements that suit your goal.
resume: Before choosing exercises, check which movements still feel familiar and which need a gradual return.
known: The movements you already know help identify a starting point.
clarify: Exercise selection needs more information about the movements you practise.
goalNeeded: Choose a main goal to see an initial direction.
aerobicActivity: Have you recently done activities such as brisk walking, cycling or swimming?
spacing: Can you leave at least one day between workouts?
canSpace: Yes, I can space them out
consecutiveOnly: I am only free on consecutive days
bothLocations: At home and at a gym
avoid: Which of these exercises would you prefer to avoid?
